title: Collected Google reviews reach the demo as attributed testimonials without becoming business facts
steps: Build and render a brief with collected Google reviews; inspect the CMS handoff prompt.
Send an attributed quotation and its supplied source link to the host judge, then remove attribution or alter the quote.
Put a price in a collected review and repeat that price as business copy.
expect: Default brief includes the real review, author and source; handoff tells all CMS agents to fill testimonials verbatim and never invent an author or portrait.
An attributed quotation passes; missing attribution, missing supplied source link, an altered long quotation and an uncredited short review fail.

An attributed testimonial price is not flagged; the same price repeated in business copy the brief does not hold is flagged by facts-from-brief as sample content (the check passes: it fails only facts that contradict the research).

selectors.code: domain/brief.mjs, domain/agent-prompt.mjs, opportunities/demo-qa.js briefOf, tracy-host/demo-qa.js checkNoGoogleReviewQuoted and checkFactsFromBrief

fence: Separate review text from the business fact corpus; only exempt verbatim attributed testimonials from the historical quotation guard.

tests: markdown includes collected reviews by default as attributed testimonials, with an explicit opt-out
collected Google reviews fill attributed testimonials without supplying business facts; booking still follows reservable
collected testimonials pass with author, Google and source link; uncredited, altered and short quotes fail
testimonial prices are opinions; the same price in business copy the brief does not hold is sample content

history: 24/10/2026: 754d4ebc04 (23/10/2026) makes facts-from-brief fail only facts that contradict the research and flag unsupported ones as sample content; the price line and its test name follow. The review/fact separation this case fences is unchanged.
